records.title: Deep Learning System and Method for Automated Detection of Diabetic Retinopathy and Macular Edema in Low-Resource Retinal Fundus Images
records.description: An artificial intelligence-driven medical imaging framework optimized for edge inference and clinical triage of diabetic retinopathy from low-resolution fundus images captured via handheld ocular devices.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. Mohanasankar Sivaprakasam, Dr. Arun K. Rajagopal

records.title: Computer-Aided Diagnostic System for Pulmonary Nodule Segmentation and Malignancy Classification in Low-Dose CT Scans Using Attention CNNs
records.description: A 3D convolutional neural network architecture with volumetric spatial attention mechanisms for early detection of lung cancer lesions in chest CT scans.

records.title: Automated Histopathology Slide Analysis Apparatus Utilizing Multi-Scale Deep Feature Representation for Breast Cancer Grading
records.description: Apparatus and computerized methodology for gigapixel whole-slide imaging analysis, tumor bed segmentation, and Nottingham histological score calculation.
records.organization: Council of Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR)

records.title: Post-Quantum Cryptographic Key Encapsulation Mechanism and Secure Hardware Module for Critical Infrastructure Protection
records.description: Lattice-based cryptographic engine resistant to Shor and Grover quantum algorithms, implementing constant-time modular arithmetic for cyber defense.
records.organization: Centre for Development of Advanced Computing (C-DAC)

records.title: Collaborative Robotic Manipulator with Compliant Actuation and Deep Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Industrial Assembly
records.description: Direct force-controlled robotic arm incorporating variable stiffness elastic actuators and safe human-robot collaboration algorithms.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. Pushparaj Mani Pathak, Rohit Gupta

records.title: Multi-Sensor Fusion Perception Architecture for Autonomous Navigation in Unstructured Road Environments Using 4D Imaging Radar and LiDAR
records.description: Real-time probabilistic sensor fusion framework with transformer-based 3D bounding box estimation designed for complex Indian traffic conditions.
records.authors_or_inventors: Dr. C. S. Shankar Ram, Sandeep Dharmadhikari
